meta.threshold: Every Commonwealth grant award must be published on GrantConnect within 21 days of the agreement taking effect (mandatory since 31 December 2017). Aggregate awards bundle many small recipients and are shown as not disclosed.
caveats: Grant totals are awarded values as published; a varied award counts at its current value. Aggregate awards and awards whose recipient was withheld sit in the not-disclosed bucket.
A recipient counts as a donor when its ABN, or a unique organisation name, matches an entity in the donor register (AEC returns and the exposed state registers). People are never matched by name.
AEC donations and state-register gifts are shown side by side and never summed: AEC returns already include state branch receipts.
A donor receiving a grant is a fact about the public record, not a finding: most programs are open and competitive, and the selection process is shown wherever the source records it.

Recipient ABNs, locations and selection processes come from each award's detail page; the share of dollars with a detail page fetched is in counts.electorate_known_share and counts.abn_known_share. Electorates are mapped from the delivery or recipient postcode and are approximate where a postcode straddles a boundary or a redistribution moved it.

grants.n: ECEC WRP
ECEC WRP
Complete roof replacement at the Spartan Basketball Stadium.

The grant activity is to contribute to the improvements of the facilities at White Hill Reserve. The grant funding will improve field lighting at the cricket and soccer clubs and update the playing field at the touch football club.
The activity will include supply and formation of pathways & grandstand slab, 3 x five tier grandstands, a two tier grandstand and two dugouts.

The Grant Activity includes grandstand seating, bench seating, team dugout shelter, fixed galvanised recycling bin and fixed lighting upgrades. Renovations to kitchen to include kitchen cabinetry and new appliances.
Construction of a shed adjacent to the existing clubhouse located at Judy Holl Sports fields, Birkdale to provide essential secure storage for club equipment.
The project will purchase machinery to allow the packaging machine and oven to provide larger serve meals.
The project will remove and replace the roof of the clubhouse at the Capalaba Bulldogs Football Club.
The project will purchase and install two shade sails over the quadrangle area of Carina State School.
The grant activity will deliver an extension of the existing deck: supply and connect downpipes to the existing stormwater drainage; install  electrical and security lighting.
